President refuses to attend CPLP conference: Marcelo does not want Equatorial Guinea to lead the organisation

stances_toward.note: Founder and host (the secretariat is in Lisbon), but the organisation is split over the 2027-29 presidency: Portugal, Brazil and Timor-Leste against Equatorial Guinea backed by the PALOP countries (Brazil said in Aug 2026 the impasse remains); Guinea-Bissau is suspended. In July 2025 President Marcelo skipped the Bissau summit over the same issue. Cooperation without control: partner, cooling. Bond - kin.
